mechanics.claim: Shadow stops upon hitting an enemy champion, marking them for 4 seconds during which they are revealed.
mechanics.quote: ''Shadow'' stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} to mark them for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.

mechanics.claim: Shadow Surge can be recast while the target is marked; on arrival the mark is consumed to deal magic damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Shadow Surge'' can be recast while the target is marked.

mechanics.claim: The dash to the marked target grants displacement immunity.
mechanics.quote: '''Vex''' {{tip|dashes}} towards the marked target with {{tip|displacement immunity}}.

mechanics.claim: If Vex scores a takedown on the marked target within 8 seconds of the mark, she can recast Shadow Surge again within 12 seconds at no cost after 0.5 seconds, repeating the effects.
mechanics.quote: If '''Vex''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against ''Shadow Surge's'' marked target within 8 seconds of its application, '''Vex''' can cast ''Shadow Surge'' again within 12 seconds at no cost after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, repeating the effects.

mechanics.claim: This bonus recast is granted even if the target died to Shadow Surge itself.
mechanics.quote: ''Shadow Surge'' grants the additional cast from scoring the takedown even if the target died to the ability.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the post-effect (i.e. after the initial cast's on-hit resolution, not on button press).
